Title: Azure Logic Apps updates for September and October 2019

Body.Content:
The Azure Logic Apps updates for September and October 2019 include features, connector updates, and announcements about regional deployments.

New features

  • File System Connector preview available in Integration Service Environment
  • Visual Studio support for logic apps in Integration Service Environment
  • New Azure Advisor recommendation for logic apps not firing when trigger fails
  • Lazy IF expression evaluation
  • Client certificate authentication for actions relaxed password requirement constraint
  • Managed identity support for Azure Functions, Azure API Management, and Azure App Services actions
  • Logic Apps definition parameters can be found as tokens in token picker
  • Azure Blob Storage connector can be used to access Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 storage accounts

 

New regions

  • France
  • Korea
  • South Africa

Connectors that became generally available

  • Azure Container Instances
  • Azure Data Factory

New connectors

  • Azure Monitor Logs
  • GoFileRoom
  • IntegrablePDF
  • Cloudmersive Document Conversion
  • Company Connect
  • ModuleQ
  • FireText
  • zReports
  • Mitto
  • SparkPost
  • SigningHub
  • Vantage365 Imaging
  • EasyVista Self Help
  • Huddle
  • Seismic
  • Elfsquad Product Configurator
  • Pushcut
  • Envoy
  • HotProfile
  • JungleMail 365

New connectors deployed to US Gov Cloud

  • Plumsail Documents
  • Plumsail Helpdesk
  • Plumsail SP
  • Plumsail Forms
  • Cloudmersive Virus Scan
